tldr: AI 需求續撐台灣半導體鏈，外資與政策資金同步進場，台積電財報前多頭氣盛。
壽險上半年稅前盈餘約 3,094 億元寫同期新高，但 6、7 月股債齊跌使動能降溫。
七月為台股 ETF 除息旺季，逾 90 檔配息，高股息與市值型仍是定期定額主力。

items.title_zh: 外資、政策資金同步進場，AI 成唯一主戰場
items.title_en: Foreign and policy funds pile into AI as the sole battleground
items.summary_zh: 台股維持歷史高檔震盪，AI 題材同時吸引外資與政策相關資金進駐，資金由 GPU、AI 伺服器擴散至整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB/CCL、電源與 HBM/CoWoS，半導體鏈續居盤面主流，財報行情前多頭氣勢明顯。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's equity market has stayed firm around record highs, with the AI theme drawing both foreign investors and domestic policy-linked capital. Money is rotating from GPUs and AI servers into rack-scale systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply and HBM/CoWoS names, keeping the semiconductor chain as the market's clear leadership ahead of key earnings.

items.title_zh: 台積電財報前，半導體鏈全線飆漲
items.title_en: Chip supply chain rallies broadly ahead of TSMC results
items.summary_zh: AI 需求強勁，台積電財報公布前台灣半導體供應鏈全面走揚，晶圓代工、IC 設計、載板與散熱同步上攻。漲勢廣度顯示推動這波行情的是 AI 算力的終端需求，而非單一個股，族群輪動仍具續航力。
items.summary_en: Strong AI-driven demand lifted the entire Taiwan semiconductor supply chain in the run-up to TSMC's earnings, with foundry, IC design, substrate and cooling suppliers advancing together. The breadth of the move underlines that end demand for AI compute, rather than a single stock, is powering the current leg of the rally.

items.title_zh: 全球半導體 2026 年估達 7,607 億美元創高
items.title_en: Global chip market seen hitting a record US$760.7bn in 2026
items.summary_zh: 法人預估 2026 年全球半導體市場規模約 7,607 億美元、年增 8.5%，改寫歷史新高，動能來自 AI 帶動的設備到晶片製造全鏈擴張。此一展望凸顯台灣在先進封裝與晶圓代工的關鍵地位，隨 AI 算力需求擴散而受惠。
items.summary_en: Industry forecasts put the 2026 global semiconductor market at about US$760.7 billion, up 8.5% year on year and a fresh record, driven by AI across the value chain from equipment to chipmaking. The outlook reinforces Taiwan's central role in advanced packaging and foundry as AI compute demand broadens.

items.title_zh: 台積電 CoWoS 產能擴四倍、6 月營收大增
items.title_en: TSMC quadruples CoWoS capacity as June revenue jumps
items.summary_zh: 台積電 6 月合併營收約 4,426.8 億元，月增 6.2%、年增 67.9%，打破近四年 6 月營收下滑的季節性。公司正把 CoWoS 先進封裝產能自 2024 年底每月約 3.5 萬片，拉升至 2026 年底每月 12～14 萬片，成長四倍以因應 AI 需求。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported June consolidated revenue of about NT$442.68bn, up 6.2% on the month and 67.9% on the year, breaking a four-year seasonal decline. The company is expanding CoWoS advanced-packaging output from roughly 35,000 wafers a month in late 2024 toward 120,000-140,000 by end-2026, a fourfold rise to meet AI demand.

items.title_zh: 金管會揭保險監理三方向
items.title_en: FSC sets three supervisory priorities for insurers
items.summary_zh: 金管會指出，保險業今年接軌 IFRS 17，未來監理聚焦三面向：推動 AI 科技轉型、引導綠色金融投資，以及建構全齡金融體系並擴大微型保險，以因應超高齡社會與氣候變遷。此監理框架將牽動壽險資金運用與商品設計方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission outlined three directions for insurance oversight as the industry adopts IFRS 17 this year: promoting AI-driven transformation, guiding green-finance investment, and building an all-ages financial system with expanded micro-insurance. The framework responds to a super-aged society and climate risk, shaping how insurers deploy capital and design products.

items.title_zh: 保險業上半年獲利創高、動能降溫
items.title_en: Insurers post record first-half profit but momentum cools
items.summary_zh: 據金管會統計，產壽險上半年稅前盈餘約 3,094 億元，寫下史上同期新高。不過壽險 6 月獲利連兩月下滑，7 月又逢股債齊跌承壓，顯示最甜蜜時刻可能已過，下半年獲利波動值得留意。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life and non-life insurers booked pre-tax profit of about NT$309.4bn in the first half, a record for the period, according to FSC data. However, life-insurance earnings fell for a second straight month in June and faced further pressure in July as stocks and bonds declined together, signalling the sweet spot may be passing.

items.title_zh: 七月台股 ETF 進入配息旺季
items.title_en: July marks peak ETF ex-dividend season in Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 七月逾 90 檔台股 ETF 除息，為全年最大配息潮，涵蓋高股息、市值型、主題與主動式基金；其中 00961 以約 18% 年化配息率居冠。顯示在指數高檔之際，收益型 ETF 對追求現金流的投資人仍具吸引力，惟需留意填息與價差風險。
items.summary_en: More than 90 Taiwan-listed ETFs distributed dividends in July, the year's busiest payout window, spanning high-yield, market-cap, thematic and active funds. Fund 00961 topped the yield rankings around 18% annualised, underscoring income ETFs' continued pull for yield-seeking investors even as valuations sit near highs.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂

items.summary_zh: 2026 年 0050、00919、00878 等市值型與高股息 ETF 仍是散戶定期定額的核心標的，主動式 ETF 亦首度擠進排行。此配置顯示市值型作為基底、股息型提供穩定現金流，可作為長期累積資產的參考策略，惟仍須注意景氣與市場波動。
items.summary_en: Market-cap and high-dividend ETFs such as 0050, 00919 and 00878 remain the core of Taiwan retail investors' regular fixed-amount ("dollar-cost") plans in 2026, with active ETFs newly breaking into the top rankings. The mix shows market-cap funds as the base allocation and dividend funds for steady income, guiding long-term accumulation strategies.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券 豐雲學堂
